title: Ukraine Drones Strike Lukoil-Volgograd Oil Refinery, Setting It Ablaze — Day 1,555
detail: Overnight into May 29, 2026 — Day 1,555 of Russia's full-scale invasion — Ukrainian long-range strike drones attacked the Lukoil-Volgogradneftepererabotka oil refinery in Volgograd, Russia, setting it on fire. Ukraine's Security Service (SBU) confirmed the strike. The Lukoil-Volgograd refinery is one of Russia's largest, with an annual processing capacity of approximately 11 million tons of crude oil, located roughly 354 km from the Ukrainian border and approximately 220 km from the frontline in Zaporizhzhia Oblast. The facility has been struck multiple times in 2026 as part of Ukraine's sustained campaign against Russian oil-processing infrastructure — which contributes to Russia's war economy by fueling military vehicles, aircraft, and missile production. President Zelensky had approved new long-range operation plans for June on May 27, targeting Russian energy and military-industrial infrastructure, stating: 'Russia's oil industry will continue to be reduced if Russia chooses war.' The Volgograd strike follows Ukraine's deep-strike campaign in May that hit refineries and oil facilities including the Vtorovo pumping station (Vladimir Oblast, May 24), the Novorossiysk port (May 23), the Voronezh airfield (May 27), and the Kirishi KINEF refinery (Leningrad Oblast, May 5). Ukraine confirmed the strike via official channels.

title: Russia Escalates to 267 Combat Attacks and 269 Guided Aerial Bombs on Day 1,555; Pokrovsk–Huliaipole Sectors Hardest Hit
detail: On May 29, 2026 — Day 1,555 of Russia's full-scale invasion — Ukraine's General Staff reported that Russian forces escalated significantly, launching 267 combat attacks across all front sectors — up from 189 on May 28. Russia also dropped 269 guided aerial bombs (KABs — glide bomb munitions launched from aircraft at stand-off range) in a single day. Additionally, Russian forces deployed 7,881 kamikaze drones and conducted 2,806 total strikes including 77 from multiple-launch rocket systems (MLRS). The Pokrovsk and Huliaipole sectors faced the heaviest fighting. In the Pokrovsk sector, Russian assaults continued near Vilne, Novyi Donbas, Rodynske, Novooleksandrivka, Shevchenko, Pokrovsk, Bilytske, Hryshyne, Udachne, Molodetske, Filiia, and Novopavlivka. The Huliaipole sector saw intense fighting near Myrne, Dobropillia, Vozdvyzhivka, Hirke, Zaliznychne, Huliaipilske, Rybne, Tsvitkove, Staroukrainka, Verkhnia Tersa, and Charivne. Despite the aerial terror campaign of May 23–28, Russian frontline advance rates remain below 2025 averages; Russia's net territorial loss in April 2026 of 116 sq km represents its worst monthly performance of the 2026 campaign.

title: Nationwide Ukraine Air Raid Alert: MiG-31K Kinzhal Carrier Takes Off, Ballistic Weapon Threat Declared — Day 1,555
detail: On May 29, 2026 — Day 1,555 of Russia's full-scale invasion — Ukrainian air defense authorities declared a nationwide air raid alert after confirming the takeoff of a Russian Mikoyan MiG-31K interceptor aircraft from a Russian base. The MiG-31K is the primary carrier platform for Russia's Kh-47M2 Kinzhal (Dagger) hypersonic air-launched ballistic missile — one of Russia's most feared long-range strike weapons with a range of approximately 2,000 km and speeds of Mach 10+, capable of reaching targets anywhere in Ukraine within minutes of launch. Ukraine's air defense command activated the alert to allow civilians to seek shelter and air defense systems to prepare for incoming fire. The threat followed Russia's latest mass strike pattern, with airspace alerts becoming routine as Ukraine tracks Russian aircraft takeoffs in near-real-time via its radar network and open-source intelligence. Previous Kinzhal attacks have destroyed hardened underground facilities; Ukraine has successfully intercepted multiple Kinzhals using Patriot PAC-3 batteries since the first confirmed Kinzhal interception in May 2023. The pattern of MiG-31K flights has intensified in May 2026 following Russia's May 24 mass strike using the Oreshnik IRBM on Bila Tserkva.

media.caption: Nationwide Ukraine air raid alert on Day 1,555 as Russian MiG-31K Kinzhal carrier aircraft takes off — May 29, 2026
